description_en: Adds chunks to a document search (document), data query (table), or image Q&A (image) knowledge base
description_zh: 使用此API可为文档搜索类（document）、数据查询类（table）、图片问答类（image）知识库添加切片
kebab_example: aliyun bailian add-chunk --pipeline-id 79c0alxxxx --workspace-id llm-19hxxxxx7htdf9lh --data-id doc_xxx --field '{"image_urls":["https://example.com/images/chunk-flow.png","https://example.com/images/parsing-result.png"],"title":"Document_Parsing_and_Chunking","content":"The_Bailian_platform_supports_parsing_multiple_document_formats_including_PDF,_Word,_and_PPT."}' --api-version 2023-12-29 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddChunk

parameters.description_en:
The chunk content to insert, passed as key-value pairs. For document search knowledge bases, use the following fixed key list:
- content (**String**): **Required**. The body content of the chunk.
- title (**String**): **Optional**. The title of the chunk.
- image_urls (**Array**): **Optional**. Image URLs included in the chunk. A maximum of 10 images are supported.

For data query and image Q&A knowledge bases, the keys are not fixed and are determined by the data source spreadsheet of the knowledge base. The key is the Excel column header, and the value is the corresponding column value.
parameters.description_zh:
插入的切片内容信息，以键值对形式传入。文档搜索类知识库使用固定 key 列表：
- content（**String**）：**必填**，切片正文内容
- title（**String**）**选填**，切片标题
- image_urls（**Array**）：**选填**，切片包含的图片链接，最多 10 张

数据查询类、图片问答类知识库 key 不固定，由该知识库的数据源表格决定：key 为 Excel 列标题，value 为对应列的值。
